end_basis: Sec. 6: "The Committee and the Commission shall terminate ninety days after the final report of the Commission is submitted to the Committee." Event-relative: end = date the Commission submitted its final report to the Committee + 90 days. No held text gives that date. The sec. 4(c) deadline (final report no later than one year after the Commission's first meeting) is a report deadline, not the report date, and the first-meeting date is not held either.

start_basis: Signed 1995-05-26 (60 FR 28507); no separate effective-date clause.
end_basis: As issued, sec. 4(b): the Committee terminates 30 days after submitting its final report. A held text now gives the report date: EO 13034 sec. 2(b)(2) refers to "the Committee's recommendations contained in its Final Report submitted on December 31, 1996" (this matches the sec. 2(f) deadline of 1996-12-31). 1996-12-31 + 30 days = 1997-01-30. The own term as issued would therefore have run out on or about 1997-01-30. EO 13034, signed 1997-01-30, extended the Committee "for the purposes set forth herein" and sec. 3(a) gave it a new term: 30 days after its "final supplemental report" (sec. 2(e) deadlines: status report 1997-04-30, final supplemental report 1997-10-31). The final supplemental report date is not held, so the as-extended end is again event-relative and unsettled. Upper bound only: EO 13138 sec. 3(g) (effective 1999-09-30) revokes EO 12961 as amended by EO 13034 as a committee that "ha[s] terminated and whose work is completed".

The extended term needs the date of the final supplemental report (deadline 1997-10-31, not the date); a queue line for that specific need is appended to FETCH_QUEUE.jsonl. Wrinkle for the reviewer: EO 13188 is dated 2001-01-12, the very day the original two-year term ran out, whereas sec. 7(f) says "extended ... prior to such date"; the recital and the stated date (2003-01-11, two years less a day) suggest the drafters counted the original term as ending 2001-01-11, so the extension may have come a day late.
